title: Build accessible Passkeys/WebAuthn conditional UI, OTP flows, and PCI-safe checkout UI

contextSnapshot.surface: SaaS sign-in with Passkeys + password fallback and subscription checkout page

prompt: Implement a sign-in form with WebAuthn Passkeys conditional UI and OTP verification, plus a Stripe-backed subscription checkout page with clean decline recovery.
forbiddenBehaviors: blocks paste on password or OTP inputs (violates WCAG 3.3.8)
starts conditional WebAuthn without feature-detecting isConditionalMediationAvailable() or AbortController
collects raw credit card numbers in custom inputs instead of PCI-isolated hosted elements or wipes fields on decline

rubricDimensions.pass: uses autocomplete='username webauthn', feature-detects isConditionalMediationAvailable(), passes AbortController signal, and allows paste/password managers
rubricDimensions.fail: forces disruptive modal WebAuthn on load or disables paste on password/OTP fields

rubricDimensions.pass: supports full-code paste with autocomplete='one-time-code' and inputmode='numeric', plus resend countdown and editable email
rubricDimensions.fail: breaks SMS autofill or forces users to type digits one box at a time without paste

rubricDimensions.pass: uses PCI-isolated Elements themed with tokens, locks Pay CTA with exact amount during submit, and preserves fields on card decline
rubricDimensions.fail: handles raw PANs in app state or clears user inputs on payment failure

negativeControls.name: blocked password paste
negativeControls.input: add onPaste={(e) => e.preventDefault()} on the confirm-password and OTP inputs
negativeControls.mustNot: approve blocking paste on password or OTP inputs

negativeControls.name: unaborted conditional webauthn
negativeControls.input: call navigator.credentials.get({ mediation: 'conditional' }) without AbortController or feature detection
negativeControls.mustNot: omit isConditionalMediationAvailable() check or AbortController cancellation

baseline.withoutSkill: blocks paste on OTP/passwords, fires unguarded WebAuthn prompts, or wipes checkout fields on decline
baseline.withSkill: wires conditional WebAuthn with AbortController, WCAG 3.3.8 paste/autofill support, PCI-isolated payment elements, and resilient decline recovery
